description: Source code for FastSourceLineResolver class implementation, part of the Google Breakpad project, handling source line resolution and related data structures.

classes.name: FastSourceLineResolver
classes.description: Implementation of source line resolution for breakpad, including module loading, address lookup, and frame info retrieval.

classes.name: FastSourceLineResolver::Module
classes.description: Represents a module with methods to load mapping data, lookup address info, and retrieve frame and CFI info.

classes.name: WindowsFrameInfo
classes.description: Data structure representing Windows frame information, used in stack unwinding.

classes.name: CFIFrameInfo
classes.description: Data structure for Call Frame Information used in stack unwinding.

classes.name: StackFrame
classes.description: Represents a stack frame with instruction pointer and associated info.

methods.name: FastSourceLineResolver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the resolver with a module factory.

methods.name: ShouldDeleteMemoryBufferAfterLoadModule
methods.description: Indicates whether to delete memory buffer after loading a module (returns false).

methods.name: Module::LookupAddress
methods.description: Looks up source info for a given instruction address within a module.

methods.name: CopyWFI
methods.description: Creates a WindowsFrameInfo object from raw memory data.

methods.name: Module::LoadMapFromMemory
methods.description: Loads module mapping data from a memory buffer.

methods.name: Module::FindWindowsFrameInfo
methods.description: Retrieves Windows frame info for a given stack frame.

methods.name: Module::FindCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CFI frame info for a given stack frame.
